items.name: Agentic Workflow Design
items.blurb: Multi-step LLM pipelines with tool use, triage cascades, and human-in-the-loop gates -- built to run unattended and fail loudly.

items.name: Context & Knowledge Architecture
items.blurb: Position-addressed knowledge bases, retrieval indexes, and CLAUDE.md/CONTEXT.md routing that any LLM harness can navigate cold.

items.name: Eval Gates & Safety Nets
items.blurb: Hard verification gates, automated test generation, requirement-to-test mapping, and refactoring pipelines that cannot ship silent breakage.

items.name: AI Enablement & Adoption
items.blurb: Took a production C++ team from 0% to daily AI use: workshops, live demos, custom skills, and SOPs that survive after the champion leaves the room.

items.name: Developer Tooling & MCP
items.blurb: Custom agents, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations; Python pipeline tooling that turns one-off AI wins into repeatable team infrastructure.

items.name: Embedded Systems Foundation
items.blurb: 4+ years of production C++/Qt on John Deere displays, 100+ defects resolved -- the engineering rigor underneath the AI work.
